title: eval-harness: integrate prompt-regression CI hooks and quality gating metrics
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add end-to-end CI hooks for prompt-set regression checks and a first-pass quality-gating metrics integration to make automated gating decisions part of PR workflows. This change wires the eval-harness results into CI so that a prompt-regression failure can block merge or open a follow-up ticket depending on threshold configuration. Summary of changes: 1) new CI hook that uploads prompt-set eval results as a summary artifact and emits a deterministic pass/fail signal based on configurable thresholds; 2) quality_gates module that computes precision/recall-like aggregates, semantic-similarity regressions, and per-prompt confidence deltas; 3) small refactor to the eval runner to emit a compact JSON summary and to tag runs with linear and PR metadata; 4) test harness and integration tests exercising threshold logic; 5) docs and example config for teams to opt in. Backwards compatibility: the hook is opt-in via repo-level ci config (ci/eval_harness.yml) and defaults to non-blocking for legacy repos. Testing: unit tests for metrics computation, staged integration runs on a representative prompt-set, and an end-to-end CI smoke test were added. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] Alerting/metrics wired - [x] Linear ticket linked (ENG-4125) Rollout plan: deploy hook to staging CI, enable on a small set of product repos for two weeks, iterate thresholds with product owners, then flip to blocking policy at 95% confidence. Related work: builds on prior eval-harness CI gating efforts (see ENG-3782) and uses the new metrics provers from ENG-4187.

review_comments: Diego Ruiz: The threshold defaults look conservative which is fine but please document the expected false-positive rate when enabling blocking policy.
Maya Patel: Added a section in docs/ci.md explaining the default non-blocking behaviour and how to tune thresholds. Also included a note on expected FP rate in the docs.
Hannah Lee: Can we reduce the artifact size emitted by the runner? The artifact upload sometimes times out on slower CI agents.
Maya Patel: We now emit a compact summary JSON with top-level aggregates and a separate per-prompt compressed archive only for full debug runs. This addresses timeout issues.
Owen Michaels: Approve pending a unit test covering the edge case where no baseline exists (first-run behavior).
Maya Patel: Added test_first_run_no_baseline in tests/eval_harness/test_prompt_regression.py that asserts non-blocking with a warning tag.
release_notes: Added opt-in eval-harness CI hooks to emit prompt-set regression summaries and deterministic quality-gating signals. Teams can opt repositories into blocking or non-blocking gating via ci/eval_harness.yml. Includes metrics computation module and integration tests. (ENG-4125, ENG-4187)
